metadata.llm_reason: Candidate skill 'Configure Multiple Repository Sources' is semantically distinct from all existing skills. It addresses multi-source Maven repository configuration (endpoints, priority, mirrors, proxies) at the session_skill layer for dependency_management task_family. Existing skills cover JavaScript bundle analysis, circe JSON library modular selection, and other dependency workflows, but none directly address the multi-repository configuration strategy. Peer candidates (Install Third-Party JAR, Maven Dependency Resolution, Configure Maven Classloading) are related but narrower or orthogonal: they handle local JAR installation, basic dependency declaration, and multi-module classloading respectively—not the orchestration of multiple remote/local/mirror repository sources with priority and proxy rules. The candidate represents a distinct capability warranting creation.
